mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which can lead to increased borrowing and investment, thereby driving up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not higher than the baseline during periods of declining FEDFUNDS, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns despite rising unemployment, this hypothesis is disproven.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth slows while inflation rises, it may signal stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If stagflation occurs without negative S&P 500 returns, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates in a tightening cycle may reduce corporate borrowing and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 rises during monetary tightening, this hypothesis is invalid.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing non-farm payroll employment signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If payroll growth doesn't correlate with positive S&P 500 returns, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts indicates weaker demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts fall without negative S&P 500 returns, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment combined with high inflation and slowing GDP growth may signal a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If the described conditions occur without negative returns, this hypothesis is invalid.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth within a specific range during expansion may indicate balanced economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production in the specified range doesn't lead to positive returns, this hypothesis fails.
